With BookLogr v1.12.0 you can now add custom fields to your books (Date, Text, Boolean, Selection, and Number types) giving you way more flexibility to track exactly what matters to you.

Full release notes: https://github.com/Mozzo1000/booklogr/releases/tag/v1.12.0
